description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0

tasks.reason: Upgrade to .NET 10 was explicitly requested. Moving from .NET Framework 4.8 (Windows-only, System.Web based) to .NET 10.0 LTS provides long-term support, modern APIs, performance and cross-platform capability.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the ContosoUniversity project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0, including project file modernization, ASP.NET MVC to ASP.NET Core migration, dependency updates, and API compatibility fixes.
